title: DSCC Community Outing
description: A day to meet new members, reconnect and make room for conversations beyond workshops.
content: Join us for an informal community gathering designed to build connections across all technical levels. We will have icebreaker activities, open discussions on tech trends, and an interactive Q&A session with senior club members.

title: Cloud Foundations Workshop
description: Build a practical foundation in cloud concepts through guided experiments and shared learning.
content: An immersive hands-on session focusing on cloud service models, containerization basics, and serverless deployments. Participants will set up cloud environments and run real microservices step by step.

title: Data Challenge Meetup
description: Bring your curiosity and work with other students on a focused data problem.
content: Participate in a collaborative data exploration challenge. Teams will analyze real-world datasets, build predictive models, and present key insights. Mentors will be present to offer guidance.

title: DSCC Kickoff Meetup
description: The season began with introductions, shared questions and a first look at what we can build together.
content: We officially launched the new academic year with an introductory session presenting our annual vision, upcoming workshops, research tracks, and OpenLab collaborative projects.
